typical_symptoms: Main leaf veins remaining green in early stages
Premature leaf senescence and early defoliation
Reduced boll size and poor boll development
visual_characteristics: Diffuse purplish-red to reddish-brown coloration across leaf blades
Clear visual contrast between reddened interveinal zones and green primary veins
Uniform to patchy bronzing across the mid-to-upper canopy leaves
lesion_characteristics: Non-discrete, diffuse discoloration patches rather than isolated spots
No distinct chlorotic halo or necrotic rings
Transition to dry necrotic tissue under severe environmental stress
color_characteristics: Dark brown dry necrotic zones in late stages
spatial_patterns: Inward progression from leaf margins toward the midrib
Irregular patches coalescing into full-leaf coverage
distinguishing_features: Absence of fungal lesions, pustules, or fruiting bodies
Green veins contrasting sharply against red interveinal leaf tissue
Systemic physiological discoloration tied to crop maturity or abiotic stress
